processGroups.name: asset.publish__full
processGroups.comments: FULL-PUSH fan-out (spark-replaceable): republishes ALL rows at head snapshot each run (no diff), then advances the shared checkpoint to head so the incremental connector resumes from there. gold->portal enrichment, silver->plain. Same topics/checkpoint as the incremental group. Run on demand for backfill/full-refresh; keep disabled otherwise.

properties.SQL Query:
SELECT ${key.expr} AS msg_key, 'upsert' AS change,
 json_object(${projection.pairs}, 'publish_ts' VALUE CAST(current_timestamp AS varchar)) AS value_json
FROM ${src.table.catalog}.${src.table.schema}.${src.table.name} FOR VERSION AS OF ${snapshot.id} t

WITH head AS (
  SELECT CAST(snapshot_id AS varchar) AS head_id, CAST(committed_at AS varchar) AS head_committed_at
  FROM ${src.table.catalog}.${src.table.schema}."${src.table.name}$snapshots"
  ORDER BY committed_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
), cp AS (
  SELECT CAST(last_snapshot_id AS varchar) AS cp_id
  FROM ${checkpoint.table}
  WHERE table_name = '${src.table.catalog}.${src.table.schema}.${src.table.name}'
  ORDER BY processed_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
), pairs AS (
  SELECT listagg(
    CASE
      WHEN data_type LIKE 'array%' OR data_type LIKE 'map%' OR data_type LIKE 'row%' OR data_type = 'json'
        THEN '''' || column_name || ''' VALUE json_format(CAST(CAST(t."' || column_name || '" AS ' ||
             regexp_replace(data_type, 'timestamp\(\d+\)( with time zone)?', 'varchar') ||
             ') AS json)) FORMAT JSON'
      WHEN data_type IN ('boolean','bigint','integer','smallint','tinyint','double','real') OR data_type LIKE 'decimal%'
        THEN '''' || column_name || ''' VALUE t."' || column_name || '"'
      ELSE '''' || column_name || ''' VALUE CAST(t."' || column_name || '" AS varchar)'
    END, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ordinal_position) AS pairs
  FROM ${src.table.catalog}.information_schema.columns
  WHERE table_schema = '${src.table.schema}' AND table_name = '${src.table.name}'
)
SELECT p.pairs AS pairs, h.head_id, h.head_committed_at, COALESCE(c.cp_id, '') AS cp_id
FROM pairs p
CROSS JOIN head h
LEFT JOIN cp c ON true

WITH xref AS (SELECT gold_asset_id, source_system, asset_uid, match_rule FROM gold.asset.asset__xref WHERE active_flag=true),
 sil AS (
  SELECT 'fortisiem' src, CAST(asset_uid AS varchar) auid FROM silver.asset.fortisiem__device__current
  UNION ALL SELECT 'rapid7_securado', CAST(asset_uid AS varchar) FROM silver.asset.rapid7_securado__asset__current
  UNION ALL SELECT 'rapid7_asyad', CAST(asset_uid AS varchar) FROM silver.asset.rapid7_asyad__asset__current
  UNION ALL SELECT 'sentinelone', CAST(asset_uid AS varchar) FROM silver.asset.sentinelone__agent__current
  UNION ALL SELECT 'fileshare', CAST(asset_uid AS varchar) FROM silver.asset.fileshare__asset__current),
 refs AS (SELECT x.gold_asset_id,
   array_agg(cast(row(x.source_system,x.asset_uid,x.match_rule,(s.auid IS NOT NULL)) as row(source_system varchar,asset_uid varchar,match_rule varchar,in_silver boolean))) AS source_refs,
   count(*) AS sc, array_distinct(array_agg(x.match_rule)) AS fu
   FROM xref x LEFT JOIN sil s ON s.src=x.source_system AND s.auid=x.asset_uid GROUP BY x.gold_asset_id)
SELECT ${key.expr} AS msg_key, 'upsert' AS change,
 json_object(${projection.pairs},
   'source_refs' VALUE COALESCE(json_format(CAST(r.source_refs AS json)),'[]') FORMAT JSON,
   'match_summary' VALUE json_object('source_count' VALUE COALESCE(r.sc,0),'fields_used' VALUE COALESCE(json_format(CAST(r.fu AS json)),'[]') FORMAT JSON) FORMAT JSON,
   'tenant_id' VALUE t."organization_name",
   'publish_ts' VALUE CAST(current_timestamp AS varchar)) AS value_json
FROM ${src.table.catalog}.${src.table.schema}.${src.table.name} FOR VERSION AS OF ${snapshot.id} t LEFT JOIN refs r ON r.gold_asset_id = ${key.expr}

processGroups.name: asset.publish__incremental
processGroups.comments: SNAPSHOT-CDC variant: reads real Iceberg snapshot increments via Trino table_changes(start=checkpoint, end=head), dedups to the latest change per key, and streams one Kafka message per changed key (upsert with full row JSON, or delete tombstone). Point at any table via set_flow_parameters (src.table.catalog/schema/name, key.expr, kafka.topic). Enrichment (gold+xref+silver source_refs) is an optional variant. Generic Iceberg-table -> Kafka publisher over Trino JDBC. Point at ANY table by editing set_flow_parameters (src.table.catalog/schema/name, key.expr, kafka.topic). change.expr is a single lightweight column expression used ONLY for change detection (e.g. CAST(t."record_hash" AS varchar) on gold, CAST(t."silver_loaded_at" AS varchar) on silver) - diffing on this one column avoids hashing every colu
